sources.title: Chatterbox - TTS Wiki
sources.snippet: Chatterbox is an open-source text-to-speech (TTS) model developed by Resemble AI and released in May 2025. Built on a modified Llama architecture with 500M parameters, it is marketed as the first open-source TTS model to include controllable emotion exaggeration and has gained attention for claiming to outperform established commercial systems ...
